name: GitHub (REST API, raw file and archive hosting)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 BR2). Shared hosting platform: dataset sources hosted here are added by extension fragments (github__<suffix>.json) with their own terms.

reliability.justification: Platform metadata is authoritative; hosted content is as reliable as its repository maintainer (graded per dataset source).

github.description: GitHub token (raises API limit 60 -> 5000/h, no scopes needed)
github.plan_hint: a fine-grained token without scopes on an account created under the corporate identity

notes: Owned by core (WP02). No sources here on purpose: each package adds the datasets/APIs it uses with an extension fragment (one owning package per provider fragment; others extend it).
